subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should ambient room_event runs use a session-stable prompt/tool contract, including the safe non-owner owner-only core tool inventory for every sender, while keeping effective visible delivery message-tool-only?
rationale: The cache fix shape is source-clear, but the owner-only tool inventory and strict-delivery split affect an authorization boundary and visible-reply product contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
options.body: Land the linked candidate after confirming ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only inventory and separated prompt-facing delivery mode.

options.title: Preserve Owner Room-Event Tools
options.body: Require a revision that keeps owner-only tools visible for owner-sent room events and accepts or separately solves the remaining cache split.

options.title: Document Strict Behavior Only
options.body: Reject the runtime change and document the prompt-cache tradeoff as part of the strict ambient-room contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
recommendation.body: Land the linked candidate after confirming ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only inventory and separated prompt-facing delivery mode.

likelyOwner.reason: This is closest to the visible-reply and ambient room-event policy history from the merged group visible-reply work.
